entities.summary: Kirill Leonidovich Knyazev is a Russian former professional ice hockey player. He last currently played for Izhstal Izhevsk in the Supreme Hockey League (VHL). He is a veteran of 331 games in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL) spanning 7 clubs.
